# Blackline 0.15.80

Built 20 September 2026. Installs over any earlier version and keeps its data. Wire protocol 8:
a build older than 0.15.69 cannot talk to this one — the app now says so instead of showing the
other person as offline.

Still **not code-signed**: SmartScreen → More info → Run anyway.

## Since 0.15.69

* **Updates arrive on their own.** From this version on, a new build is fetched and verified
  (signed manifest, checked hash) without anyone sending a file around.
* **A name is yours only when the name server says so.** Claiming used to say "yours" the moment
  the claim was sent. Now it says "sent" until the published log carries it.
* **Pictures over 100 KB send again.** The middle-size preview was never sealed, so every larger
  picture silently failed.
* **Permissions that were decorative are enforced**: read history, voice messages, pin messages.
* **Someone at a gated space's door** now shows on the space's tile, with a notification.
* **Calls**: the overlay hides when the pointer rests; the down arrow fills the whole
  conversation; the volume row in a tile's menu no longer runs into the row below.
* Per-space profiles removed (nicknames stay). Permission descriptions shortened.
